---

> **TOGAF ADM Note — Phase B–D**: This catalog is the authoritative traceability reference for all Architecture Building Blocks (ABBs) defined within the Data Security domain. Each row maps an ABB to its parent L2 capability, TOGAF phase, status, and paired Reference Architecture Document (RAD).
>
> **ABBs are solution- and vendor-agnostic.** They define *what* architectural capability must exist, not *how* it is implemented. Solution Building Blocks (SBBs) are defined in Phase E–F and are not recorded here.

## Status Vocabulary

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `draft` | Authored and conformant with the L3 ABB template; under architecture review |
| `review` | Under active architecture review |
| `active` | Approved and available for realization — may reference as binding architectural guidance |
| `planned` | GUID reserved; ABB not yet authored — do not reference in solution designs |
| `deprecated` | Superseded — do not use for new designs |

[strategy/guidance/security/Data/GUID-SEC-DATA-ABB-MATRIX-2.5.11.md#architecture-backlog--planned-abbs]

## Architecture Backlog — Planned ABBs

The following Component ABBs have been identified as required by the Data Security L2 Capability Map but are not yet authored. GUIDs are reserved here to prevent duplication.

| Reserved GUID | Capability | Gap Description | Dependency |
|---|---|---|---|
| GUID-SEC-DATA-ACCESS-GOV-2.5.07 | Data Access Governance | Policy-based data access control and entitlement review architecture | Requires alignment with IAM ABB hierarchy; joint authoring with Identity domain |
| GUID-SEC-DATA-PRIVACY-2.5.08 | Data Privacy and Residency | Privacy-by-design architectural requirements and data residency governance | Requires alignment with Information domain governance and legal/compliance leads |
| GUID-SEC-DATA-LIFECYCLE-2.5.09 | Secure Data Lifecycle Management | Retention, archival, legal hold, and secure destruction architecture | Dependent on Data Classification ABB maturity |
| GUID-SEC-DATA-INTEGRITY-2.5.10 | Data Integrity and Non-Repudiation | Tamper evidence, hash verification, and audit accountability architecture | Dependent on Encryption and KMS ABB completion |
